title: Set a power rack's safety arms for a lifter's bench press
instruction: Set the rack's safety arms for this bench press.
context: Benching alone in a power rack is safe only if the safety arms sit just below where the bar touches the lifter's chest: a failed rep then lands on the arms instead of the lifter, and a full rep is never stopped. Too low and the bar can pin the chest; too high and the lifter can't finish a rep. Trainers and gym staff set this for each lifter, from where the chest is, and both sides must match.
setup: Station table; cm from the midpoint between the arm bases, x forward, y to the robot's left. A scaled power rack, one rigid 20 kg unit: two dark grey uprights 3 x 3 x 26 cm at x 32, y -16.5 and +16.5, on feet 14 x 3 x 1.2 cm, each with eight white notch marks on its inner face at 3.0, 4.5, 6.0, 7.5, 9.0, 10.5, 12.0 and 13.5 cm, and a J-hook at the top. A steel octagonal bar 2.2 cm across and 40 cm long rests in the J-hooks along y at x 32, its centre 20 cm up, with two black octagonal plates 9 cm across and 1.2 cm thick on each end at y +/-18.1 and +/-19.3. A black bench 39 x 10 x 4 cm runs along x from 22 to 61, with a lifter figure lying on it, head toward the robot: head 4 x 4.5 x 3.6 cm at x 23 to 27, blue torso 16 x 13 x 4 cm at x 28 to 44 (chest top 8 cm above the table, under the bar), arms at the sides, dark hips, legs to x 61. Two red safety arms, each a bar 23 x 2 x 1.5 cm along x from x 17 to 40 at y +13.5 (left) and -13.5 (right), slide vertically on the uprights and click into the notches (the height of an arm is its top surface); each has a red handle 2.5 x 2 x 3 cm standing on its near end at x 18.25. The left arm starts at the top notch (13.5 cm), the right arm at the bottom one (3.0 cm).
scoring: Scored at the end, from each safety arm's top-surface height. The bar touches the lifter's chest when its underside is 8.0 cm above the table. 0 if the rack was moved more than 1 cm or turned more than 3 degrees, or if either arm is below 7.0 cm (a failed rep would land on the chest first). Otherwise: 1.0 if both arms are between 7.0 and 8.0 cm (the 7.5 cm notch); 0.5 if one is there and the other is at 8.0 cm or higher; 0.25 if both are at 8.0 cm or higher (safe, but a full rep is blocked).
reset_notes: Put the left safety arm back at the top notch and the right one at the bottom notch; nothing is consumed.
fidelity: The rack, bar and figure are one rigid body at about one fifth scale. The safety arms are slides with a simulated pop pin: a firm pull unlocks one, it follows the gripper, and it locks into the nearest notch once still. The lifter doesn't move and the bar isn't lifted; the score checks where the arms would catch it.
